purpose: Graphite is a node editor, close to a patch bench. I want to see how it shows code and controls together.

pages.title: GraphiteEditor/Graphite
pages.reaction: A node editor that wants to be a game engine for pictures. I like that the screenshots are procedural: a polka dot pattern made by a graph, not by hand. But the page is mostly a pitch and a donation appeal, and I could not see how code and controls actually sit together. Some interest, not a lot. I am …
